text.p: The average yield at the latest auction of six-month discount treasury bills stood at 49.39 percent, the same as at the last sale on October 29, a central bank statement said on Friday.
The results of Thursday's auction, compared to the last
issue of six-month discount T-bills, were as follows:
Amount sold 3.58 million UAH 9.93 million UAH
Actual amount raised 2.88 million UAH 7.97 million UAH
The central bank sold 35,848 T-bills, the bank's statement

The date of the next auction of six-month discount T-bills is scheduled for November 5.
The average yield at the latest auction of nine-month discount treasury bills stood at 58.12 percent, the same as at the last sale on October 29, a central bank statement said.
The results of Thursday's auction, compared to the last issue of nine-month discount T-bills, were as follows:
Amount sold 3.23 million UAH 22.22 million UAH
Actual amount raised 2.25 million UAH 15.49 million UAH
The central bank sold 32,318 T-bills, the bank's statement said. Of those 24,219 were competitive and 8,099 were non-competitive bids.
The date of the next auction of nine-month discount T-bills is scheduled for November 5.
The average yield at the latest auction of 12-month discount treasury bills stood at 60.94 percent, the same as at the last sale on October 29, a central bank statement said.
The results of Thursday's auction, compared to the last issue of 12-month discount T-bills, were as follows:
The central bank sold 1,580 T-bills, the bank's statement said. Of those, 913 were competitive and 667 were non-competitive bids.
The date of the next auction of 12-month discount T-bills is scheduled for November 5. --Kiev newsroom +380 44 229-2264
